title: Capacity intake routing and forecast ledger for Dedicated reservations
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a single canonical playbook and machine-readable ledger for Dedicated capacity reservation intake that ties request routing, approval SLAs, and forecast budgeting into a repeatable workflow. Goal: reduce end-to-end reservation turnaround time and improve capacity utilization accuracy by 10% within the quarter. This ticket scopes intake forms, approval matrix, routing rules (sales vs self-serve vs SRE triage), and the forecast ledger that feeds capacity planning and finance forecasts.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical intake form published in Confluence with required fields and SSO-proofed links
Routing matrix implemented in the intake service (routes to sales ops / self-serve / SRE) with unit tests
Approval SLA targets defined: 24h for self-serve (<10k tokens/min), 72h for sales-assisted (>10k tokens/min) unless marked high-priority
Forecast ledger prototype (CSV + API) that aggregates pending + committed reservations and exports to finance dashboard
Integration smoke test between intake and provisioning estimator (PM-7612 referenced) completes end-to-end in staging
